title: Possible rounding loss in StakingPool.claim under-pays rewards
root_cause: StakingPool.claim() computes reward as (stake * rate) / PRECISION with integer division applied before multiplying by elapsed time, which may truncate small claims to zero.
attacker_capabilities: call any public function from an EOA

severity_justification.worst_case: Small stakers receive zero rewards over many epochs.
severity_justification.realistic_case: Stakers below ~1e6 wei lose sub-wei amounts per claim; aggregate impact unclear.
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: Immunefi v2.2 — theft/loss of yield (needs quantification).

asset_delta: Suspected per-claim truncation; exact amount not yet computed.
false_positive_risks: The division order may be mathematically equivalent for realistic stake sizes; needs a concrete numeric example.
invalidating_conditions: Invalid if PRECISION division is applied after the time multiplication.

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: No minimum-claim threshold exists in claim().

assumptions: Assumes typical small-staker sizes; not yet bounded.
triager_summary: Plausible rounding issue but no call trace, no PoC, and no quantified loss. Needs a runnable example before it can advance.
